tool.name: List.otulabels
tool.description: Lists otu labels from shared or relabund file
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$otu' otu.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #if $otu.is_of_type("mothur.relabund"): #silent $mothur_args.append("relabund=otu.dat") #elif $otu.is_of_type("mothur.shared"): #silent $mothur_args.append("shared=otu.dat") #else #silent $mothur_args.append("list=otu.dat") #end if #if $label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str(str($label).replace(",","-"))) #end if #if $groups: #silent $mothur_args.append("groups=" + str(str($groups).replace(",","-"))) #end if
echo 'list.otulabels(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.name: otu
param.label: list or shared or relabund - OTU List or Shared or Relabund

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The list.otulabels_ command lists otu labels from shared_ or relabund_ file. This list can be used especially with subsampled datasets when used with output from classify.otu_, otu.association_, or corr.axes_ to select specific otus using the get.otus_ or remove.otus_ commands
.. _list.otulabels: https://mothur.org/wiki/list.otulabels/ .. _classify.otu: https://mothur.org/wiki/classify.otu/ .. _otu.association: https://mothur.org/wiki/otu.association/ .. _corr.axes: https://mothur.org/wiki/corr.axes/ .. _get.otus: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.otus/ .. _remove.otus: https://mothur.org/wiki/remove.otus/ .. _shared: https://mothur.org/wiki/shared_file/ .. _relabund: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.relabund/
